final_verdict.summary: Approve revised release preparation and its explicit separately approved exact-C operation prerequisite; no primary installation is authorized by this review.

review_metadata.role: independent Evaluator bounded revised pre-code release review
review_metadata.resolution: Release preparation now excludes destination mutation. A separate exact-C operation contract must be independently approved and must cover complete external backup verification, pre-mutation state comparison, current-owner decision/application binding, safe-lane continuation, drift guard, guarded rollback preserving intervening work, controller and four native checks. Actual execution and independent acceptance are explicit prerequisites to readiness success and final closeout. Disposable prior-release rollback remains honestly distinguished from actual-primary preservation.
review_metadata.scope_boundary: Existing release process and three declared validations are retained. No concrete self-install operation, owner continuation, installation, source QA, tag or publication is accepted here; those remain separately gated. No source/test/contract edits or installation performed.
